model: 1D U-Net (U-Time style) over D-alpha, line density, beta_N, W_MHD and injected power; 5 folds, each holding whole run days out; docs/labeler/confinement_ours.md

segmentation.active: total beam power >= 200000 W, gaps of at most 50 ms bridged
segmentation.confidence: mean probability of the segment's class over its bins
segmentation.confidence_floor: a segment under 0.7 is category 5 (uncertain); `predicted` keeps its class

columns_meaning.category: 1 high, 2 low, 3 qh, 4 wpqh, 5 uncertain (under the floor)
columns_meaning.predicted: the segment's class, before the confidence floor
columns_meaning.source: held_out: a curated shot, read by the fold model that never saw it; ensemble: any other shot, the mean of the five fold models
columns_meaning.tier: unreviewed: a QH or WPQH segment on a shot outside the curated set (the curated set leaves out ELM-free and other quiescent H-modes the network could read as QH); model: the rest
columns_meaning.extrapolated: true for a shot past the last curated one (196493); the network never saw those campaigns

reasons.200007: no segment of 20 ms or more while the beam is on

prediction_source.curated shots: the fold model that never saw the shot
prediction_source.other shots: mean of the five fold models

coverage: Active (beam-on) bins only; other time is not assessed, not low. On curated shots only that share of the label time lies inside a curated interval; the rest is the network's reading of time nobody curated.
